scope: Actual source-extracted app.js storage/capacity/export branches with real storage codec and capacity/view functions; memory Storage and DOM counter stubs. No browser was started and native modal/focus semantics are outside this probe.

cases.name: all-copies-removed-existing-behavior
cases.observed: The pre-existing storage listener ignores key=null and has no missing-both-copies branch. In-memory progress/capacity/export remain available; expected-snapshot guard rejects a later write.

limitations: Removing all save keys (including localStorage.clear) does not immediately close settings or warn; this listener is unchanged from V5.11. The result still describes retained in-memory progress and export, while a later write is rejected by full expected validation.
